contentBody.rawHtml:
Make the most out of your enhanced subscription

Dear ,

 

We would like to remind you that your subscription now includes access to Funds and Investor news, data and tools, offering you a complete solution to meet all your global infrastructure needs.

 

Identify investment opportunities, win more deal mandates, and stay ahead of key market drivers and trends.

Explore New Features

Gain complete visibility into the full lifecycle of an infrastructure investment dollar—from commitment by an LP, through fundraising, deployment, asset construction, and eventual sale or refinancing.

You now have access to:

4,000+ Funds

Looking for your next fund or monitoring fundraising trends? Our Funds data provides detailed profiles, including descriptions, structure, status, size, investments, and more

Asset Radar

Our predictive tool forecasts assets coming to market, helping you build a customised pipeline of potential investment, advisory, or financing opportunities

LP Intelligence

Build a list of potential LP investors with 11,000+ LP profiles, including data on direct investments, fund commitments, past activity, and more

II Direct

Our Institutional Investor database gives you access to detailed transaction information with II involvement

Explore New Features

You also now have Funds data aggregation & visualisation capabilities.

 

Easily conduct market and trend analysis, visualise market shifts, and create reports - all without leaving the IJGlobal platform.

Access Market Analytics Tool
Access Funds Data Dashboard

Want to navigate the new platform like a pro? Unlock the full potential of your enhanced IJGlobal subscription with IJGlobal 101, our live training webinar. Hosted twice a week, you can pick a session to suit you.

Alternatively, if you have any questions or need assistance, please contact clientsupport@ijglobal.com
